description: A single home link holding the colour Monark butterfly and the product name. The mark is an inline SVG marked aria-hidden (it is decorative next to the name), so the link has one accessible name: by default "{Product}, by Monark: home", which starts with the visible product name.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the brand link.
Follows the link to the site's home page.

focus.notes: A 2px ring in the ring colour shows on keyboard focus (focus-visible) only, around the whole brand.

screenReader.notes: The product name stays real text, so it is translatable, selectable and read correctly. MonarkMark on its own becomes role="img" when you pass a title; without one it is hidden from assistive tech.

contrast.text: The product name uses text-foreground (18:1 on the Monark cream background, 17:1 on espresso).
contrast.ui: The butterfly is decorative; its red-to-orange gradient is fixed by the brand.

consumerResponsibilities: Point href at the locale root on localised sites (/fr, not /).
Keep clear space around the mark; don't place other logos or text inside the brand link.
